notes.content: The page continues a previous sentence and then discusses possible underlying sets for an axiomatization of ateliers: the family F, M, or L. It contrasts the simplicity of the data with transparency of the essential axioms. It gives three proposed structures on F in (1.16), annotates choice b) with a dated objection, explains a map to a power set through deployment and incidence, and introduces the incidence relation in (1.17) before an intended diagram of six fundamental relations. The intended diagram is not drawn on this page.
notes.math_reading_decisions: The two straight left-angle signs are \ll; the curved order sign with curved lower rule is \preccurlyeq. P is plain upright here. The map has a simple right arrow and the element notation has an initial vertical bar and tilde. The brace begins under et, not under \ll. The incidence triangle is closed and points left. The defining equivalence has clear dfn above and an uncertain par-like mark below. The same conjunction F≤G and F∈M appears in the incidence gloss and definition. Singular le plus transparent is retained literally. No mathematical repair is made for typography, compressed prose, the canceled sign, or the doubled/retraced F.
